product_brief: Hardware module providing cryptographic services via Ethernet/IP, typically embedded in network appliances for large-scale cloud infrastructures.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer) and ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen) algorithms. Validated under NIST CAVP program.
crypto_primitives: AES-CBC, AES-CMAC, AES-CTR, AES-ECB, AES-GCM, AES-KW, AES-CBC-MAC, ECDSA, EDDSA, Hash DRBG, HMAC-SHA-1, HMAC-SHA2, HMAC-SHA3, KAS-ECC-SSC, KDF TLS, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, RSA, SHA2, SHA3, SHAKE-256, TDES-CBC, TDES-ECB
fips_validated: Yes (NIST CAVP validated; references FIPS 186-5, FIPS 203/204 implied by ML-KEM/ML-DSA, SP 800-90B, SP 800-56Ar3)
primary_platforms: Stand-alone network appliance, large-scale cloud infrastructures
testing_&_validation_methods: NIST CAVP (Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program) conformance
